title: [server] Migrate label consumers (teams aliases, tasks, platform-mcp, chat, triggers)
commit: refactor(server): resolve labels from AgentRole, not Agent.role

D1_apiRoleField.decision: KEEP the field name `role` (no new fields); SOURCE it from `TeamMember.roleId → AgentRole.key` (machine key), NOT `AgentRole.name`
D1_apiRoleField.deviationFromTodo1: Todo 1 §6 DTO recommendation suggested carrying `AgentRole.name` in the `role` field. REVERSED here, with reason.
D1_apiRoleField.reason: The web consumes `.role` as a machine RoleKey, not as display text: `ROLE_KEYS.includes(role)` / `toAvatarRole(role)` / `roles[key]` colour lookup (web/app/(main)/agents/page.tsx:444,1565,1644,1666-1668; teams/[id]/session/page.tsx:310-331,367-368; TeamMembersPanel/message-input etc.). `AgentRole.name` is the human label (产品经理/开发者/计划员) which fails `ROLE_KEYS.includes(...)` (keys are product/developer/plan), so `toAvatarRole` would fall to its developer fallback and change the plan/architect avatar colours. `AgentRole.name` is used for the ALIAS label (D2), not for this field.
D1_apiRoleField.byteIdentity: For seeded data: verified live `team_members.role_id IS NULL` = 0 rows (all 28 members bound), and every builtin `AgentRole.key` equals the old `agents.role` value (product/project_manager/architect/developer/tester/plan/librarian) — so `role` is byte-identical before/after on every seeded response.
D1_apiRoleField.nullContract: Unbound member (`TeamMember.roleId` NULL) or missing role row → `role: null` (was also null for such rows before, since a NULL `agents.role` produced null).

D2_aliasLabel.decision: `defaultAlias` resolves the human label from `AgentRole.name` when the member is role-bound, else falls back to `agent.name` — the pre-migration fallback rule is unchanged.
D2_aliasLabel.byteIdentity: For seeded data `AgentRole.name` === the old `ROLE_LABELS[role]` (产品经理/项目经理/架构师/开发者/测试/计划员/知识管理员), so aliases are byte-identical.
D2_aliasLabel.emptyLabelForbidden: A missing mapping NEVER renders an empty label: `roleLabelOf(...) ?? agent.name` → `<agent.name>-<seq>`.

D3_platformMcpCompatRole.decision: `resolveByAgent({policyId, role, agentKey})` keeps being passed the compat `role` argument, now sourced from `AgentRole.key` (not `profile.agent.role`).
D3_platformMcpCompatRole.reason: `AgentPolicyInput.role` is documented inert (todo 3: `兼容字段：不参与解析`). Value-identical for seeded data → todo 3's `toHaveBeenCalledWith({policyId, role, agentKey})` assertions keep passing. Comment at the call site records that todo 8 owns its removal.
